tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam can chos kyi rgyal po las kyi gshin rje'i man ngag gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba bzhugs/

chos rgyal man ngag chen mo dge'o/ / bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po ya manta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa dang*/ de'i man ngag rwa ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por rgyun gyis gtor chog ni/ gtor ma gru gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la sogs pa khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed gang yang rung ba'i bdag skyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa dang gtor ma yi dam ltar byin gyis rlabs/ rten yod na amṛ ta sa bsangs/ rten yod med gang yin rung swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus rang gi mdun du pad nyi la gnas pa'i ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa rwa brdar zhing rmig pa rdeb pa/ dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad brdzis shing gsod par byed pa shin tu 'jigs pa'o/ /de'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas hūṃ gcig spros te/ hūṃ de las thod skam gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug to'am be con hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags tshogs mchod/ sems can gyi don byas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu rnams bsdus/ sa bon phyag mtshan la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ las kyi gshin rje sku mdog mun pa ltar gnag pa/ shin tu ches khros 'khrugs rngam pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ral pa khams ser gyen du brdzes shing phyogs kun tu g.yengs pa/ rab khraus ma he'i gdong mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ yang na srin po'i zhal ras/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug to nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon dus kyi zhags pa nag po dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gnod byed la bsdigs par mdzad pa/ sku sbom zhing thung ba gcer bu ling ga gyen du sgreng ba/

zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas ma he la gnas pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan thod rlon gyi do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yon du hriḥ las mdung rtse gsum pa hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros las gsum mdzad 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ srin mo chen mo tsa mu ṇḍī dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can nu ma rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas tri shu la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa snying khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon skum g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa glang po che'i ko rlon gyon pa rgyan dang cha byad las kyi gshin rje dang mtshungs shing*/ yab yum gnyis ka me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'dzam gling dbus kyi phyogs mtsho ma dros pa'i sa 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya nas/ dam can gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ srin mo chen mo tsa muṇḍi 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha gshin rje gshed rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal tu gsol/ oṃ badzrī bha wa abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus gang*/ nyes skyon dag /yab yum gnyis kar gyi spyi bor rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya dang yi ge bcu gcig pa lan gsum gyi mthar sa mā ya st+waṃ zhes dam la bzhag / oṃ kā la rū pa sa pā ri wa ra bhyaḥ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod do/ / oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ yi dam chos skyong gnyis ka'i sngags kyang yin/ chos rgyal nyid mchog tu nye bar byed pa'i nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge bcu gcig pa ste byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags so/

/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yakṣa hūṃ/ mahā ro ṣa ṇa ya ma rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni bsnyen pa'i sngags te snying po'o/ / oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yakṣa hūṃ mahā ro ṣa ṇa ra siddhi yo sarba bhu ta a dhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i sngags te rtsa sngags so/ / oṃ kā la rū pa ya sarba sha trun duṣta trā sa ya trā sa ya/ a gaddhya a gaddhya sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bandha bandha/ tsurṇa tsurṇa/ tsakṣa badzre ṇa gho ra pa drā ya kṣe tra pā lā' ye/ tstshin da tstshin da/ bhin da bhin da/ thāṃ kaṃ badzra nā da ru dhi ra arghaṃ? pā ya ya bā ra ya badzra ya nā sha ya stam bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi 'phreng sngags te gshin rje bye ba ther 'bum gyi sngags so/ / hriḥtsa munṭi ye sarba sha trun duṣtan dhu na dhu na bandha bandha ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ hūṃ dzā la dzwa ra dzwa re ṇa bye dhi ro ga ṇaṃ nyi ga na shi baṃ yaṃ haṃ raṃ ri tshus ya a be sha ya dzi baṃ hri da ya/ tshindha tshindha/ bā' dya pa shi ghraṃ mā ra ya/ na sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo tsa muṇḍī'i 'phreng ba'i sngags te ma mo bye ba ther 'bum gyi spyi sngags so/ /'phreng sngags 'di gnyis la sngags btu med cing*/ skabs 'gar legs sbyar rang du'ang ma nges pas/ 'don tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re 'dug kyang*/ dag ther byas nas khungs che ba'i phyogs nas bris pa'o// oṃ hriḥtsa munṭī ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni yum tsa muṇḍi'i snying po ste yab kyi nye snying dang snying po dang rtsa sngags thams cad kyi zla sdeb la 'di kho na spel te sbyar ro/ /'dir tsa munṭī ces pa'i gzhug tu baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dang*/ tsaṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyor ba'ang yod do/ /rgyu mtshan la brtags na gnyis ka mi 'gal kyang*/ dpe rnying ba rang tsho na mi 'dug cing*/ mgo na hrīḥyod phyin sa bon gnyis sbrags dgos kyang mi dgos pa 'dra'o/

/de dag thams cad blo la byang bar byas nas skabs 'dir thams cad tshar gcig brjod de/ 'phreng sngags ma gtogs gang yang rung ba gcig brgya rtsa sogs cung zad bzlas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por slar yang gsal btab/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ/ i daṃ ba ling gṛhṇa gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun las mi nyung bas yab la phul/ oṃ hriḥtsa munṭi ye i daṃ ba ling sogs gong bzhin sbyar ba lan gsum mam lngas yum la phul/ oṃ kā la rū pa tsa munṭi ye zhes pa mgo bor sbyar nas arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyi mchod/ 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni/ /ma dros mtsho yi 'bri dkyil na/ /ri nag dgu yi pha mtha' ste/ /spos ngad ri yi bar dag na/ / mchu dang zhing du cha mnyam mtsho/ /de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po bzhugs/ /'gro ba kun gyi lus kyi bdud/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun la gnas pa ste/ /phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba po/ /'jigs pa khyod kyi gzugs mthong zhing*/ /gshin rje khyod kyi dri ngad ldang*// rtse na 'gro ba'i srog gi bdud/ /ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa ste/ gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srin po'i lcam mo gshin rje'i yum/ /dus mtshan srog gi bdag mo ste/ /rgya mtsho chen po bdun la gnas/ /tsa munṭi la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs 'phrin las gzhol/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs shis pa brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/ sogs smon lam btab yig brgya dang bzod gsol bya/ rten yod na chos skyong pho mo gnyis la brtan zhugs byed cing*/ khyed kyi sems can don kun sogs gtor 'gron rnams gshegs/ rten med na chos skyong nyid kyi ye shes pa yang gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang gi lte bar thim pa'o/ /smon lam dang bkra shis gong gi de kas cho ga mod/

spro na 'dir yang byed pa mi 'gal lo/ /gal te drag po'i las la dga' ba'am/ de nyid kyi sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor yin na/ gzhan gong dang du 'dra ba las/ gtor ma sha khrag gi rgya mtshor mos te/ gtor sngags snga mas phul ba'i de ma thag tu/ / sgrub bya dgra bgegs byad ma rnams bkug ste gtor ma la thim/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba bighna na sha trun mā ra ye/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsa munṭi sarba bighnan sogs de bzhin du sbyar bas phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs gong bzhin 'dod don gsol ba'i mthar/ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ / zhes sogs gtso bo yab yum gyi bskul ba dang*/ dug mtsho nag po rba klong 'khyil ba nas/ /ro langs rngam pa dgu yi khri steng nas/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro ma tsa munṭī/ /bzhengs nas 'gal byed thal ba rdul du rlog /'jam dpal shin rje gshed kyis bka' byung gi /srin mo chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i dmag sna khyod kyis drongs/ /zung zhig chings shig bsad pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bskrad dang dbye dang rengs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phur bus btab dang mnan pa'i las mdzod cig /dgra bgegs sha la zo zhig khrag la 'thung*/ /ming gi lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod/ / ces las mkhan gyi tshul du yum bskul lo/ /rtsa sngags kyi nyes skyon dang*/ u ni sha la seng ge te/ gsod byed mthar thug pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang zhal rgyun no/ /de ltar na gtor chog gi rim pa ste dang po'o/ / da ni 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rim pa la brten nas/ 'gal byed thams cad chom la 'bebs pa'i thabs bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por mkho ba'i yo byad bsags pa ni/ ro ras sam dpa' bos rin gyis nyos pa'i ras la/ sngags bzlas pa'i chus bkrus/ bgegs bskrad bsrung ba bya/ nye snying cung zad bzla'o/ /ras 'dul gyi dus gri khrag dang mngal khrag dang dug sna rnams cung zad byug

/sku 'bri sar dri bzang gis ya dang bhyoḥ'am hūṃ dang hriḥgang rung 'bri/ nye snying bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ skya bris kyi skabs ro sol gyis cung zad bri bar 'dod de/ mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'ang min/ sku gzugs khru tshad tsam byed par gsungs pa mtshon byed yin/ de bas chung ba dang che ba'ang mi rung ba min no/ / skabs 'dir chos rgyal yab yum sbags te sgrub pa'i dbang du byas na/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi bris sku dgos pas/ de la gshin rje pho mo lcam sring ltar bsgrubs na bris sku so sor byas kyang rung*/ gcig la bris kyang rung mod kyi/ yab mngon rtogs ltar dang*/ tsa munṭi yab kyi gdan la mi bzhugs par/ g.yas g.yon 'og gsum gang rigs su gdan zur sa la 'bri/ zhabs g.yon brkyang du byed/ kha cig srog chags kyi gdan med pa dang*/ gzhan dag ma he'i gdan byed par yang 'dod mod/ tsa munṭi ni ro langs kyi gdan la gnas pa nyid yin no/ / 'on kyang 'dir yab yum du sgrub pa nyid bsngags par bzhed pas/ de'i tshe yab kyi gdan ma he la yab yum gnyis rtsar bzhugs te/ yum gyi zhabs kyang g.yas brkyang ngo*/ /dngos su mnyam sbyor du 'bri ba dang sgom pa dag med kyang*/ zhabs stabs de ltar byed pa de ni don gyis mnyam sbyor mtshon no/ / 'dir bla ma'i zhal nas/ gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde'i srung ma bstan pa skyong ba'i bskor bdag tu bsgrubs na zhing skyong gi tshul du bsgrub dgos te/ 'di nyid kyi 'phreng ba'i sngags las kyang kṣe tra pā la zhes gsungs mod gsungs/ zhing skyong brgyad kyi gshin rje gshed de gdong brnyan can du bshad pas/ las gshin ma he'i zhal can du mdzad pa 'di man ngag yin/ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i sgo nas mngon spyod la sogs pa'i las tshogs tsam sgrub pa la ni ma he'i zhal mtha' gcig tu dgos pa min te/ rtog bdun gyi gzugs brnyan sbyor ba'i skabs khro zhal du bshad/

de skabs kyi man ngag las kyang khro zhal du 'byung ba dang 'dra/ rtog pa 'di nyid nas ni gsal kha rang med kyang*/ gnyis kar rung ba'i 'then phyogs yod de/ kho bo cag gi bla ma brgyud pa ma gtogs mkhas mkhas mo sus kyang ma go bar 'dug go / dkor bdag la zhing skyong du bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci snyam na/ zhing skyong zhes pa'i ming gis kyang der go dgos shing*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dkor bdag che shos de mgon po yin/ mgon po thams cad zhing skyong yin/ 'dir yang gshin rje mgon po nag po chen po'i lugs su sgrub pa yin no/ /spyir zhing skyong la mgon pos ma khyab/ mgon po la zhing skyong gis khyab pas zhing skyong du sgrub tshad la gdong brnyan dgos par ta ga la nges kyang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dgod pa la/ dur khrod kyi zhing skyong de ltar yod pa de/ 'dir de ltar byed pa'i sgrub byed du sbyor ba ni bla ma dam pa'i man ngag yin no/ / gzhan dag yi dam chos skyong zhal ras mthun pa'i ched yin ces zer te cal col lo/ /ling ga gyen sgreng du mdzad pa ni/ sgrub tshul gzhan la mi dgos kyang*/ gshin rje de nyid las mkhan lha mgon dang dbyer med par ngo bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ dgos pa ni/ 'di la man ngag gi gnad cung zad cig yod pa de bsnan na/ sgrub thabs gcig gis lha gnyis kar 'grub pas lag len 'khyer bde ba dang*/ de'i steng du yang man ngag cung zad dang bcas na sgrub po nyid kyi srung mar sgrub pa'i skabs/ zhor la dbang sdud la sngags pa yin ces nged kyi bla ma gsung ngo*/ /'di yang gzhan tshos ma go /sku gcer bur 'dod phyin dbang po 'chang ba dang*/ sbas pa mi rung bas 'di 'dod dgos mod gzhung 'di las gcer bur gsungs pa yang med/ gcer bu bkag pa'ang med pas/ rtags mngon par mi byed na stag lpags kyis smad dkris so/ / rtog pa las rgyan med rus pa'i 'phreng ba can ces gsungs pa la/

kha cig thod skam gyi do shal las rgyan gzhan med zer ba dang*/ rgyan gtan med du 'dod pa sogs yod kyang*/ 'dir rgyan med pa'i don ni/ rin po che dang me tog sogs sgeg mdzes kyi rgyan med pa'i don no/ /de yang drag las kyi dbang du byed nas gsungs pa ste/ gzhan zhi ba la rgyan med pa dang rin po che'i rgyan phra mo/ rgyas pa la rin po che'i rgyan mang po/ dbang la me tog sogs dang*/ de dag la ci rigs par dar gyi na bza' yang mi 'gal lo/ /rus 'phreng zhes pas mgo 'phreng dang rus rgyan dngos su gsungs/ stag lpags dang sbrul la sogs pa yang bkag pa ni ma yin no/ / yum la ba glang gi lpags pa dang gos nag sogs man ngag gi yi ge rnams las sna tshogs byung kyang*/ rwa phyi ma'i yi ge na glang lpags su bzhed cing*/ rtog pa las gsus chen ces gsungs pa lha mo sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid la mi sbyor bar/ dud 'gro'i mtshan nyid la sbyar te glang po cher 'dod pa'o/ /de'i tshe smad g.yogs ma yin stod g.yogs yin mod/ smad gcer bu'am stag lpags can ji ltar byed yab la ji ltar bris pa dang mthun par bya'o/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra gyen brdzes sogs yab dang mthun no/ / bcu gsum ma'i lugs la yum dbu skra grol ba dang na bza' ba glang gi lpags pa can yin kyang*/ de 'dir bsre mi dgos so/ /yi ge la la nas sku sbom thung dang gsus pa rgyas par bshad pa la bsams nas/ ha cang sbom thung thal ba dang*/ grod 'jol che grags pa mi legs shing*/ kha cig gshin rje yin pas shin tu skem pa byed zer ba la yang rgyu mtshan med pas/ yab yum gnyis kar zhal tshad brgyad pa'am bdun pa gang rung du bri bar bya zhing*/ yum la lha mo'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir kha spu mi 'bri ste 'dir ma zad mgo brnyan med pa kun la de ltar go bar bya'o/ /bris sku de la yab yum gnyis ma gtogs bla ma yi dam chos skyong gzhan sogs/

lha mgron gang yang mi 'bri/ dur khrod pa rnams ma gtogs 'khor yang mi dgos so/ /skya bzo grub/ mtshon ma btab pa'i bar der/ thugs kar yi ge bdun pa/ mgrin par bsnyen sngags spyi bor nye bsnyen lte ba man chad kyi cha la 'phreng ba'i sngags bri/ yum gyi gnas gsum char du snying po dang lte ba man chad la 'phreng ba'i sngags bri'o/ /

skabs der yang sbyar ba dang khrus gsol dang*/ sngags de rnams nyid mang du bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mtshon bkye zhing spyan dbye yan grub pa na/ zhag de nyid la rab gnas bya ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bum bskyed sngon du btang*/ bgegs sbyang ba dang byur bsal ba dang*/ khrus gsol rnams nan tan du byas/ de nas mchod gtor dang dam rdzas rnams rgya cher bshams/ 'don cha gtor chog dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi snying kha nas hūṃ spro ba mi dgos/ mdun bskyed gzhan dang 'dra bar sa bon las bskyed/ skyed ma thag tu yi ge bcu gcig pa bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa 'don/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren lan bdun sogs tshar gang mang byed/ snga ma de la phyir 'brang gi bgegs skrod dgos/ dbang bskur rgyas btab tshar ma thag tu/ yi ge bcu gcig pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs par gsungs pa las/ yi ge snga ma rnams la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas me tog gtor gsung ba yod kyang*/ lag len la me tog dmar nag gam dkar dmar gnyis bya/ dkar po'am nag po la yi ge bdun pa stong phrag gcig bzlas/ dmar po la yum gyi snying po lnga brgya bzlas/ de nas me tog gnyis bsres/ ye dhar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang*/ oṃ hrīḥtsa munṭi tra ga rakṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gnyis sbrel nas brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te me tog 'thor/ de nas rjes brtan zhugs kyi bar 'dra/ ji ltar 'os par tshogs 'khor mtshon pa zhig med ka med yin/ de nas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang 'byung po spyi gtor btang nas mgron rnams gshegs gsol dang smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ / de tsam gyis rab tu gnas par 'gyur la/ dang po 'bri ba nas brtsams te rab gnas ma grub kyi bar la/ rang dang lha bris pa dang*/ chos 'di zhus pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dam rab gnas byed mkhan ma gtogs shin tu gsang ba gal che'o/

/de nas kyang dam tshig dang mi ldan pas ma mthong ba dgos shing*/ phal cher la gsang ba rang legs so/ /'di dam tshig bris sku'i tshul yin/ byin rlabs che zhing 'phrin las dang rtags mtshan shin tu myur ba'i gnad yin la/ de min bris sku dkyus ma rab gnas can gyis kyang*/ dmigs rten sgrub rten rung tsam ni yin no/ /bris sku 'bri tshul gyi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o/ / ༈ da ni 'khor lo 'bri tshul bshad par bya ste/ bri gzhi ni zhing chen la bkab pa'i ras sam dar ram so ras sogs 'byor na rab/ de min shog bu la gri khrag dang*/ dug gis cung zad byugs/ bya rog gi khrag dang*/ ro sol dang*/ bong bu'i chu dug khrag rnams cung zad bsres pa'i sna tsha dang*/ bya rog gi gshog ru'am mi rkang gi snyu gu byed par bshad pa/ de la dngos su 'grub na rab/ ma 'grub na rkang gi sbubs su snyu gu bcug pa'am/ snyu gu la rus pa de dag bcings pas kyang rung*/ zhes bla ma gsungs/ de nas 'khor lo dngos ni/ zlum skor gsum byed dgos pa las/ thog ma tshangs zur skam thig bzhi btab/ lte ba btsal nas ji ltar 'os par skor ba las/ gal te sor lnga bskor yod na/ sor gsum pa'i mtshams su gcig bskor/ dbus kyi g.yas g.yon du sor gcig gis mtshams su gcig bskor/ de rnams kyi phyi nang gang yang rung bar yi ge shong tsam gyi mu khyud re yang bskor/ dbus kyi lte bar yi ge 'bri tshul ni/ dgra mang po'am dmigs bsal med pa'i gnod byed spyi la byed na rim pa ltar sarba sha trun rgyal grong pa rnams ni bā/ ra ya zer ba lta bu dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa rnams ky-i sarba sha trun ni bā ra ya zhes pa lta bu 'bri ste/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre shes dgos/ dmigs bsal re re la byed nas sarba zhes pa mi 'bri ste/ sha trun tsan skyabs ni bā ra ya zhes pa lta bu 'bri/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/ de'i mtha' phaṭa gyi skor ba'am phaṭa gnyis kyi bar du bcug

/dbus su ya gcig 'bri ba'ang yod/ lte ba'i mu 'khyud la oṃ kā la rū pa dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya nā sha ya staṃ bha ya bha smi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bri ste/ re mig brgyad pa nang ma la yab kyi 'phreng sngags kyi phyed snga ma 'god dgos pa las kha cig spel tshig mi dgos zer/ rwa shar ba dang rgya stong sogs bar skabs kyi mang po zhig re re bzhin dgra bo ma ra ya phaṭa ces pa 'bri gsungs/ de yang 'gal ba cher med cung mi bde/ 'dir rwa 'bum sogs nas brgyud pa'i man ngag ni tshig lan gnyis gnyis yod pa rnams la bar du ming tsam spel ba ste/ dper na trā sa ya che ge mo trā sa ya zhes pa lta bu'o/ / lan gnyis ma zlos pa rnams la ming thog mar spel te/ che ge mo ru 'dir arghaṃ ba zhes pa lta bu ste/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi 'khor lo'i re mig phyi brgyad nang brgyad kyi yi ge 'god tshul kun la de ltar nges par bya'o/ /rang lugs lag len 'di la byed de/ de yang dbus kyi yig mgo phyogs de shar/ g.yon lho/ smad phyogs nub/ g.yas phyogs byang du byas pa'i shar du tra sa ya tra sa ya/ shar lhor a kadhya a kadhya/ lhor sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ lho nub tu ha na ha na/ nub tu da ha da ha/ nub byang du pa tsa pa tsa/ byang du bandha bandha/ byang shar du tsurṇa tsurṇa zhes pa rnams la dbus su ming spel lo/ /mu khyud bar ba la snying po yi ge nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la spel tshig nang gi dang 'dra ba 'bri/ phyi'i re mig brgyad la/ shar du che ge mo tsakṣa badzre ṇa gho ra pa dra ya/ shar lhor che ge mo kṣe tra pā lā ya/ lhor tshindha che ge mo tshindha/ lho nub tu bhindha che ge mo bhindha/ nub tu che ga mo thā kaṃ badzri bā dang*/ nub byang du che ge mo tu dhi ra arghṃ pā/ byang du che ge mo ya mā ra ya/ byang shar du che ge mo badzra ya nā sha ya staṃ bha ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa 'bri/ mu khyud phyi ma la rtsa sngags kyi 'jug tu spel tshig snga ma bzhin bya/

de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo de nyid las gshin rje'i lto bar chud pa 'bri/ dbus kyi yig mgo phyogs la sku stod yong ba byed/ gdan pad nyi dang ma he mi dgos/ ro gang na tsam bya gsungs/ gdan mi byed pa'i srol yang 'dug go / yum gyi 'khor lo yang skor thig drug dang lte ba'i yi ge yang gzhan yab dang 'dra/ dbus su hra'am bhyoḥ'abri ba'ang yod/ re mig nang ma brgyad kyi shar du dhu na che ge mo dhu na/ shar lhor bandha che ge mo bandha/ lhor ma tha che ge mo ma tha/ lho nub tu pra ma tha che ge mo pra ma tha/ nub tu che ge mo hūṃ dzwa la/ nub byang du dzwa ra che ge mo dzwa re ṇa/ byang du che ge mo bye dhi/ byang shar du che ge mo ro ga ṇaṃ/ rim pa phyi ma'i shar du che ge mo nyid gdan shi baṃ/ shar lhor che ge mo yaṃ haṃ ri tshus ya/ lhor che ge mo a be sha ya/ lho nub tu che ge mo dzi baṃ hri da ya/ nub tu tshindha che ge mo tshindha/ nub byang du che ge mo bā dya pa/ byang du che ge mo shi ghriṃ mā ra ya/ byang shar du che ge mo na sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di'i mu khyud gsum ga la oṃ hriḥtsa muṇḍi dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya nā sha ya staṃ bha ya bha smi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa kho na 'bri'o/ /'khor lo de lha mo tsa munṭi'i lto bar chud pa 'bri/ de yang gong bzhin ro gdan tsam mam gdan spang pa'o/ / yab yum gyi 'khor lo'i mu khyud dang re mig bcu drug po'i yi ge rnams drag po'i las la mgo nang bstan byed pa la rtsod pa med/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum sgrub na mgo phyi blta byed ces 'ga' zhig bzhed mod/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo la de bzhin yin kyang*/ 'di las kyi gshin rje'i 'khor lo yin pa'i phyir las thams cad la yig mgo rnams nang bstan kho na byed ces bdag cag gi bla ma gsung ngo*/ /'on kyang 'khor lo 'di la brten nas las gsum po de dag sgrub pa med bsam na/

ma yin te dngos bstan gyi 'khor lo 'di kho na la yang*/ zhi ba'i nang tshan bsrung bzlog gnyis dngos su yod/ rgyas pa dang dbang gi las byed pas dngos su cung zad dkon kyang de dag gi bar chad bsrung ba dang bzlog pa la nges par 'jug pa yin no/ / bsad las kyi spel tshig ni gong bzhin yin la/ dbye bskrad rmong rengs kun la'ang mā ra ya zhes pa'i tshab tu de dang de'i spel tshig 'jug pa yin no/ / de'i tshe bris gzhi snag tsha la sogs pa yang bsgyur dgos te spyi dang 'dra'o/ / dngos bstan 'di min par man ngag gis lde bsgyur ba'i las gsum gyi 'khor lo ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ / yang bla ma skyo ba rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ zlum skor rim pa gnyis la mu khyud re re byed/ de nas thig bzhi snol mar btab pas/ nang ma le tshe dgu dang phyi ma la brgyad yod pa de thig lhag po re re btab pas dkyil 'khor gyi gdung thig 'dra ba yi ge shong ba re byed/ lte ba gru bzhi la ma ma sha trun che ge mo zhes pa 'dri de'i mtha' phyogs bzhi'i gdung la ma ma sha trun mā ra ya zhes pa kho na 'bri tra sa ya la sogs pa sngags tshan brgyad po yang g.yon skor gyis 'bri ste phyi ma la'ang des rigs 'dre/ mu khyud gnyis ka la'ang yi ge 'god tshul ka gdung dang 'dra/ yum gyi 'khor lo la re mig nang ma brgyad la a mu ka sya hūṃ na sogs sngags tshan brgyad po yongs rdzogs tshar re re 'bri/ phyi ma brgyad la nyi gdan sogs sngags tshan brgyad po yongs rdzogs tshar rer 'bri bar 'dod do/ / yang skyo ba kha cig ni yab yum gnyis kar la re mig nang ma brgyad po dkyus dang 'dra ba la khyad par ni g.yon bskor yin/ phyi ma brgyad yab yum mtshungs par tsakṣa sogs dang nyi ma sogs yongs rdzogs 'bri ba'i lugs kyang 'dug go /dbus kyi yi ge mgo yab kyi g.yon dang yum gyi g.yas la ston no/ / de dag ni phyi'i yig rigs dang dpe rigs sna tshogs mthong na/

the tshom za ba bzlog pa'i phyir dang lugs so so go ba'i phyir bkod pa yin gyi lag len du gdab bya ni dkyus kho na'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo bris ma thag rab gnas bya ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed bum sgrub dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'khor lo la sbyang ba dang bgegs bskrad drag tu bya/ phyir bsal ba sogs mi dgos/ las bum gyis khrus gsol bya/ 'khor lo bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su bhruṃ yig nag po las ji ltar bris pa dang mthun pa'i lcags khang sgo med khang mig bcu bdun pa/ dug dang me dang mtshon cha 'phar rgyug byed pas gang ba'o/ /de'i lte ba'i yig 'bru las gshin yab yum du bskyed/ gzhan sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams re re bzhin ya las byung ba'i gshin rje dang*/ bhyoḥ'am ma las byung ba'i gshin rje mo rnams cha lugs ma nges pa'am/ yang na las gshin yab yum nyid dang 'dra ba re bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ snying gar sa bon ya dang bhyoḥre bskyed/ de dag dus gcig tu gsal thebs pa dka' bas re re bzhin rim pas gsal 'debs kyi/ bris gzhi'i sku 'dra gnyis kyang sa bon las mi bskyed snying po lan bdun bdun gyis chos rgyal yab yum du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ spro na mig tu kṣiṃ sogs kyang 'god/ de nas ye shes pa chos rgyal yab yum phyi nang gnyis dang*/ gshin rje bye ba ther 'bum dang ma mo bye ba ther 'bum spyan drangs te bstim pa rnams dmigs pa shugs che la drag pas lan mang du bsgom/ bum chus gtor zhing dbang bskur/ dbang rtags rdo rje nag po rtse lnga 'ba' zhig yin/ skabs 'dir dam rdzas kyi gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la phul/ mchod bstod dang las bcol rgyas par byas/ lha rnams zhu ba las/ yig 'brur gyur ces zhal bsgyur/ bris gzhi'i lha bsgyur mi dgos/

su pra tiṣṭhā dang ye dhar dang nye snying po'i rtsa sngags rnams brgya rtsa sogs gang mang dang*/ 'khor lo gnyis kyi sngags kyang nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas te/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad nas 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i byin rlabs thams cad gshin rje yab yum gyi rtsa sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas 'khor lo'i sngags la yang yang bstim/ me tog nag po yang yang 'thor ro/ /me tog kyang sngon bris sku bzhin bsgrubs na legs par mngon mtshams 'dir mchod bstod brtan byed yig brgya dang smon lam bkra shis re bya/ de nas bsgrub bya'i ming yig rnams bris la bsgrub bya dngos su bskyed/ bden bdar dang dgug gzhug drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog chen mo bzhin lan mang du bya/ hrīḥṣtiḥ'am ya ma rā dza'i mthar/ gshin rje yab yum gyi snying po btags la dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes btags pa drug cu tsam dang*/ dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba 'go ba'i lha dang bi dhye shā ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa drug cu tsam bandha bandha dang stam bha ya zhes btags pa'ang drug cu tsam bzlas zhags pas bcings/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan btson srung rnams kyis bskor bar bsam/ slar yang gtor ma dang mchod pa phul nas re zhig 'jog pa'am yang na de ma thag lteb rtsis byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de'i tshul ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /gshin rje pho mo'am bshan pa pho mo'i 'khor lo 'bri tshul gyi rim pa ste gsum pa'o/ / da ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rim pa rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por bsnyen pa la dbye na rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni bsnyen pa rang dang bsnyen pa tsam po dang bsnyen pa chung ngu dang bsnyen rkyang dang rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang gzhi'i bsnyen pa rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /de yang dam tshig bris sku sngar yod na legs/ nges par dgos pa ni min/

der ma zad bris 'bur dkyus ma tsam gyi rten bshams thub na ni legs/ med kyang chog ste/ gnas dben par mchod gtor bsham/ gtor ma 'dzin gtor du bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsam rjes chog gi mthar thug par gtor chog tu bshad pa'i skabs bzhin yin pa las/ rten gzhan med kyang 'dzin gtor nyid rten yin pas bsnyen pa ma grol bar mdun bskyed yab yum gshegs gsol mi byed/ 'khor dang mgron rnams gshegs/ thun phyi ma rnams la yang lha sku snga ma 'od gsal du bcug nas slar bskyed pa yin pas 'don pa bsgyur ba mi dgos so/ / gang ltar yang nye snying yi ge bdun pa la 'bru 'bum byed/ bsnyen rdzogs dngos snying po la 'bum phrag gsum bzla bar bshad do/ /nye bsnyen gyi sngags sam rtsa sngags grangs bsnyen du byed na 'bum phrag gcig bzla/ bsnyen pa chung ngu'i skabs rtsa sngags dang 'phreng ba'i sngags la grangs bsnyen ma bskyal kyang rung bas thun gyi mjug tu cung zad re ka bzlas pas khyab bo/ /yi dam gyi sngags spyir grangs med tshad med du bzla dgos shing khyad par du yang bye ba gcig nas lnga'i bar bzla bar gsungs pa sgrib sbyong dang tshogs gsog dang dngos grub dang las tshogs mtha' dag gi rgyu yin no/ /bka' srung 'jig rten 'das pa 'di kun yang de dang phyogs mtshungs tsam spyir yin mod kyang tshul ston dbang gis de tsam du bzla ba dgos pa chung zhing*/ 'khu ldog mang pos mtha' med du bzla mi dgos la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir sngar gyi de tsam la rtags med na nyis 'gyur ram gsum 'gyur ram bzhi 'gyur gyi bar du bzlas zhing rtags kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dam gyi sngags ni dus rtag tu ci nus su bzla dgos pa yin pas de gnyis cung zad mi 'dra'o/ /yi dam gyi bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na 'di'i bsnyen pa byar mi rung*/ yi dam ni thob thang gi gshin rje gshed gang la brten kyang mchog yin mod/
spyir khro bo'i rgyal po gzhan la brten kyang mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ /

mngon spyod kyi las mtha' byas pa dang*/ gzhan la 'di nyid kyi dbang rjes gnang byas pa dang*/ sngar ma thob pa'i mi la 'di'i sgrub thabs lag len bstan pa sogs kyis byin rlabs kyi bkrag mdangs ci rigs pa re yal 'gro bas/ slar bsnyen pa kha gso cung zad re byed dgos so/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa song nas las gshin dgos kyi'am yi dam dang sbrags pa'i sbyin sreg lnga stong ngam khri tsam 'bul/ de bas mang ba rang mi dgos/ gtor chen gcig dang gtor chung mang du bshams nas gtor ma brgya tshar stong tshar sogs 'bul lo/ /spyir 'di nyid chos skyong gi gtso bor byed na bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen skabs skabs su bskyar gyin byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nas dus skabs gzhan la nye bsnyen byed na dam tshig bris sku 'grub par byas nas bla ma dkon mchog mchod cing*/ nang gtor phul nas gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bshags pa sogs bya/ yul lha bzhi bdag la gtor ma btang*/ bgegs bskrad cing tho btsigs/ de'i steng du srung ba'i don du las kyi gshin rje ral gri thogs pa bzhugs par gyur/ sngags mang du bzlas/ me tog gtor gu gul bdug /'dir brgyud pa gong ma nus pa brnyes pa rnams kyi myong grub zhal gdams la/ spyir yang bod yul 'dir bsnyen sgrub byed pa la rgyal bsen the'u rang dang bcas pa la klu'i rgyab skyor ba 'di ka bar chad che zhing*/ dgos su las gshin nag po bsgrubs pa las pe dkar gyi 'khor rnams kyi bar chad gtong bas/ de dag la dmigs nas bgegs gtor glud sogs rgya cher tsam btang ngo*/ kho ra'i sger gyi gtor chog byas nas 'brel chung nas bar chad gtong du 'gro bas mi bya/ kho la dmigs nas sil gtor bgegs gtor spyi'i cho ga rang byed/ bgegs gtor bskyar gyin btang na kho yang bskyar nas log yong bas yang yang mi byed/ lan cig po de sngags grangs mang la dmigs pa gang gsal byed/

skrod pa'i tshe yang sngags dang dmigs pa drag la yun ring bas mtshams gcod dgos so/ / de rjes mtshams bsdams sgrub khang gi nang du bris sku lho la zhal gzigs pa'i mdun du ranganyid kha byang bstan nam/ yang de go ldog na yang bzang*/ rang dang bris sku gdong thad yong ba gcig byed dgos/ go skabs mi bde na kha blta phyogs la khyad tsam med/ rtags kyi gtor ma kha zas bzang tshad las byas shing dam rdzas kyis brgyan pa rul mi 'gro ba cig thod pa'am lcags snod du bshams/ dar nag gam ras nag gi bkab bo/ /de'i drung du mchod yon rakta lag bur dang tsha ba gsum dang tsha sna btab pa zhig kyang bshams te kha gcod do/ /bris sku'i mdun du 'dzin gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang mchod pa bshams thun gtor re yang bya ste thun thams cad la 'grub na rab/ de tsam ma lcogs na srod thun la phul kyang rung mod/ skya rengs shar ba'i dus su phul na bzang ba yin no/ /skabs 'dir bzlas pa ni rtsa sngags nyid nye bsnyen gyi sngags su gsungs pa'i phyir gtso bor de bzla dgos la/ sngags thung gzhan gnyis ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ yum gyi sngags ni rtsa sngags ji tsam song ba de'i phyed tsam bzla ba yin no/ /spyir 'phreng sngags la bsnyen pa ma song yang 'khor lo sgrub tu mi rung ba ma yin mod/ /bsnyen pa song na las myur ba la shin tu gal che ba gcig kyang yod do/ /de ltar na rab tu 'phreng sngags gnyis po 'bum phrag gcig /'bring du khri phrag bzhi/ ma mtha' la khri tsam gyis kyang rung ngo*/ /gtor chog dkyus ma de song ba'i skabs rtags kyi gtor ma'i khebs bsal/ kha gsos/ nang mchod kyis bran/ byin rlabs rgyas pa bya/ rtags byung na 'bul lo zhes byas nas de ma thag khebs bkab/ yi dam gyi snying po dang rakta'i sngags kyi bsrung ba bya/ rakta'i arghaṃ la yang de dang 'dra/ rtags ni dang por mi nag po dang rgyal po dmag dpon dpa' bo'i rigs dang go mtshon can dang kla klo dang bandhi nag po dang*/

tshom po dang shan pa sogs yab kyi cho 'phrul la 'ong*/ ma sring dang bud med dang*/ mtsho chen po dang chu bo rgyug pa dang*/ khrag mtsho sogs yum gyi cho 'phrul yin/ mun nag dang mi dang rlung 'tshub sogs gnyis ka'i cho 'phrul la 'ong*/ mdze sbrang dang hrul po hrul mo sogs sel gyi ltas yin pas yig brgya dang bshags pa bya/ rad rod can dang na ba'i rnam pa 'dug na grib kyi phog pa yin pas khrus gsol sogs byed/ 'bag seng dang me chen dang rgyal po sgra dang thog 'tshig pa dang*/ sa 'gul ba dang*/ sgo srog pa dang*/ bya gdug pa can dang gcan gzan sogs ni rtags dang bar chad gnyis ka la 'ong bas/ rjes shes la brtags na shes dgos/ spyir bsrung bzlog drag tu byas pas rtags yin na gong 'phel la 'gro/ bar chad yin na sangs 'gro/ mthar rtags rab bris sku bzhad pa dang*/ dngos su mthong ba yin kyang deng sang phal che ba la 'byung ba dkon/ gong gi de rnams rang la 'dud pa dang*/ shin tu dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed pa dang*/ ma he la bzhon nas rgyug pa sogs yin par grags/ rmi lam du zhal mthong gi rnam pa rab rib 'byung ba yang srid/ zhu ba can phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ ma sring gzugs dang*/ chas gos phun sum tshogs pa'am bud med nag mo phyag 'tshal ba byung na nges pa can du byed/ sngags kyi rtags gtor dang rakta mchod yon du phul nas yi dam gyi sngags drag tu bzla ba dang*/ mna' bkag dam la bzhag /las sbyor drag tu bya'o/ /gtang rag rgya chen po tshogs 'khor byed pa yang gal che/ de nas rjes bsdus te/ de ma thag gam dus gzhan du'ang rung ste drag las kyi sgrub pa la 'jug go /bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen ji ltar sgrub pa'i rim pa ste bzhi pa'o/ / da ni sgrub pa la 'jug pa bshad par bya'o/ /de yang ye shes lha'i sgrub pa ma yin/ drag po mngon spyod bsad las kyi sgrub pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bsgrub bya de'i brten skyob kyi lha rnams kyis bar chad 'chad rtsom nyen che/

de las gzhan pa'i lha 'dres dkyus ma'i bar chad 'byung nyen chung ngo*/ /nye bsnyen gyi skabs bzhin sngon 'gro dge ba'i dpung rnams bya/ rgyal 'gong la bgegs gtor gtong ba'i dod du bsgrub bya'i gsang sde rnams bgegs gtor sbyin/ bgegs bskrad drag tu gzir zhing de ma thag bsrung 'khor sgom pa gal che/ nyi phyed yan la yig brgya bzla ba dang*/ de man chad mngon rtogs sgom ste/ yi dam gyi sngags drag tu bzla/ de lta bu zhag gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa'i rigs la sngar ma bsags na rdzas rnams bsags shing 'khrul 'khor skabs 'dir nges par 'bri'o/ /de yang 'khor lo'i rgyu rnams la sbyang ba bya/ khrus chus gtor/ mchod rdzas la sogs pa rdzas kyi rigs gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du byed/ rdzas kyi gtso bo thod pa mtshan ngan la/ yi ge mang po na dum bu gcig gam gnyis pa la zer ba 'dug kyang*/ gzhung yi ge ma dag pa bklags pas phyis gsal byed/ byas pa kun kyang ma dag go / des na dpe rnying 'ga' las dum bu drug gam brgyad pa las zhes 'byung ba ltar bya ste/ dum bu brgyad drug gnyis rang bzhin gyis mtshan ngan yin cing gcig pa dang gnyis pa mtshan ngan nyung bas so/ /thod pa de'i 'breg mtshams cung zad mtho ba dpral ba dang*/ ltag khung gi kha la thig btab ste gras bdar legs par byas/ chu dron gyis mi 'khrur/ ma thod rnyan gyi phyogs la gshin rje'i dbu phyag gi rnam pa rang grub yod pa ste/ gong 'khor lo 'bri ba'i rdzas kyis skya ris gsal btab/ tshon rtsi rnams la dug bsreg la gshin rje nyid kyi sngags mang du bzlas te tshon rngam 'jigs kyi rnam pa yong bar bya/ de la pra tshil mnan no/ /'grub na pra tshil ma mnan gong du sku de'i spyi bor nye snying dang*/ mtha' skor du rtsa sngags/ zhal dang phyag la oṃ kā la rū pa sha nan na ma rbad ru lu ru lu bhyo dzaḥru lu tshal pa ya ni to sha ru ni nan mā ra ya nan oṃ zhes pas bri/

gal te zhal dbye 'di ma 'byor na thod pa mtshan ngan pho thod mo thod kha sbyor du byung na'ang nus pa che bar 'ong zhing pho thod kha sbyor dang*/ mo thod kha sbyor yang rung tsam yin no/ / zhal dbye yod pa'i dbang du byas te ka pā la'i rgya srub ma rnams la rdzas snga ma ltar gyis snying po dang rtsa sngags dang yum gyi snying po rnams drag po'i spel tshig can 'dra/ ya thod ma thod gnyis kar gyis dbus su dug khrag gi ya chen po re 'bri/ ya ma rwa dza spel tshig can gyi mtha' skor la 'bri zhes gsung sgros las 'byung ste/ sngags 'di yi dam gyi sngags su byed pa dang*/ 'jig rten gshin rje'i sngags su byed pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ltar yin no/ /bsad las la spel tshig dgos pa thams cad du bshad tshod thob thang mā ra ya zhes pa kho nas chog kyang*/ da ltar lag len du de tsam gyis rnon po mi yod pas trig nan e hur thum dzaḥmā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ches 'bri ba las myur ba'i man ngag yin/ mthu mkhan 'ga' zhig bring shag ces sogs kyi mtha' rten 'dzug pa'ang 'dug /nus pa yong 'phro yin zer ro/ / 'on kyang de ni rbad sngags dang 'brel gyi/ 'khor lo dang 'brel ba ma yin no/ /zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo*/ /'khor lo shin tu rno bar 'dod na mjug tu lha srin gang la gtod par 'dod pa'i lha 'dre de sde brgyad gang yin brtags nas de'i srog snying spel tshig dang bcas pas skor/ ya ma rā dza adzñā pa ya ti rbad ces pa bar bar du spel ba lag len man ngag yin/ de nas shog bu la rdzas sngags bzhin gyis dgra bo'i ling ga spyi dang mthun pa la/ snying gar ming gi mthar yab kyi nye snying dang*/ yum sngags kyi mthar spel tshig can gyis bskor/ phyi'i mtha' skor du snying po dang rtsa sngags dang yum sngags spel tshig can gyis bskor bar bya/ 'khor lo dngos gzhi'i ming yig bsgrub bya'i zag rdzas kyis byug pa byung kyang legs/

ma byung kyang cho ga ling ga 'di la zag rdzas lnga po gang rung gcig med kha med dgos/ des dang por mi 'khyam/ bar du bla 'khor/ mthar bla mi 'bros pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de la 'brub khang du dgug gzhug drag po lan mang du byas/ yab yub gyi sngags gnyis la dgug gzhug gi sngags btags pa yang lan mang du byas nas/ 'khor lo'i gsham gyi phyogs su mgo bstan te 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du bcug /ling ga'i snying kha na yod pa'i sngags dang 'khor lo gnyis kyang lto bar sbyor bar bya/ lag pa bde bas yi ge phra zhing 'khor lo chung na ma bltabs pa dam rtsis sbyar te kha sbyor 'grigs sor bzhag pas legs blta'i tshigs dgos pa byung na brang thum zer ba'i blteb tshigs de byed/ de yang yab gtsor che bas phyi nang gi bltab lugs ma nor ba yab 'khor la byas pas mdun blteb yin/ yum 'khor la phyi klog dang rgyab bstan shugs la 'ong*/ 'khor lo'i rgyab steng dang*/ sug bzhi 'og tu yong ba'i rtsis kyi steng 'og mi 'khrul ba'i rtags btab nas drag po'i dkris spyi dang mthun par bya/ yang blteb tshigs ma byas kyang dkris ni dgos/ mo 'khor 'og dang pho 'khor steng du bya/ de rjes lag len lugs gcig la thod pa rdzas ngan sa bsob kyi 'ol spyi bkang ba'i steng du 'khor lo bzhag lte ba'i yig mgo dpral ba'i phyogs su bstan/ 'khor lo la rgyu mnga' mi rus sam mi lpags kyi srad bu btags/ dpral ba'i phyogs nas bton/ 'khor lo'i steng du yang rdzas than thun 'grems/ yang lag len lugs gzhan la 'khor lo blteb tshigs byas pa de ling ga'i snying gar gzhug /ling ga'i rgyu yang dgra bo zag rdzas bsres te 'jim pa'am bag zan la byed/ de yang dang po ling ga khog stong bcos la skam/ der 'khor lo bcug ste kha sgrib bo/ /de'i snying kha'am lte ba'i thad du ag tshe khung yong ba bya/ de la mthun lam btod nas thun 'debs pa'i lugs kyang yod/

de gnyis gang ltar yang de nas ma thod gshin rje'i gzugs kyi steng nas bkab thod pa'i phyi nas ro skra dang rgyu ma srad bu sngo nag gis rgya gram ris su thod pa phyed mthong tsam du bsdam/ bden stobs dang drag sngags mang du brjod/ sha chen dang gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar yungs nag bsres la bsrung ba byas te bzhag go / sgrub pa'i dus kha lta phyogs la spyir gshin rje lho phyogs na gnas pas lho la lta zer de/ kha cig spyir btang ba de ltar yin yang rtog pa 'di'i lugs kyi byad du lta dgos zer/ gzhan dag 'di lho phyogs kho na'i gshin rje ma yin/ dbus kyi gshin rje yin pas lta phyogs la nges pa med/ dgra gang yod kyi phyogs la lta zer/ 'on kyang 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ drag las spyi'i cho ga la dgos par lhor bltas kyang rung*/ dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir dgra phyogs la bltas kyang chog pa yin cing*/ kha lta phyogs 'di dag sgrub pa po gtso che'am/ mdun skyed gtso che zhe na/ gzhan dag sna tshogs 'chad kyang rang lugs sgrub pa po gtso che'o/ /des na sngar bzhin bris sku yod na dkyil 'khor la sogs pa mi dgos/ bris sku med na gru gsum mthing nag phyag mtshan bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bri/ rang dang bris sku'i bar du 'brub khung blos bslangs khru gang las mi chung ba zhig bya/ bris sku'i mdun du gtor ma sha khrag snying la sogs pas brgyan pa dang drag po'i mchod rdzas spyi mthun las mi rta khyi gsum gyi sha khrag dang ra nag nya sbrul rnams kyi sha dang sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang*/ tshil chen gri khrag nya skam ra nag gi dbang po lnga rnams sres pa'i gu gul gyi bdug spos rnams dgos/ skam thun rlon thun spyi dang mthun par bshams shing sgrub lugs kyang 'dra/ sngags ni rtsa sngags kyi mthar kā la rū pa kṣaṃ ma dug tsa tsa tshal pa rbad rbad ma dug kṣaṃ ya la kṣaṃ zhes pa'o/ / cho ga'i rim pa ni mchod bstod kyi bar gong dang 'dra ba las/

bzlas pa'i mgo mjug gnyis car du gtor bsngo re byed/ 'grub na gtor chung la sogs re bya/ de ma lcogs na gtor ma che ba kha gsos pas kyang chog /'khor lo gnyis dang ya thod ma thod gshin rje yab yum dang 'brub khug lcags khang du sgom/ zhes 'dod pa dang*/ thod pa ril po lcags khang du 'dod pa gnyis yod mod/ cung zad mi bde bas zhal dbye yin na 'brub khung du ya thod gshin rje'i pho brang zhal dbye dang 'khor lo gshin rje yab yum du bskyed/ ya thod kha sbyor yin na 'brub khung du thod pa dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed kyang chog /yang na 'brub khung gzhal yas khang dang thod pa gnyis 'khor lo dngabacas pa yongs rdzogs yab yum du bskyed kyang rung ba yin no/ /skyed chog mdun skyed ma dang mnyam du byas pas yong*/ ling ga dang ming yig bsgrub bya dngos su mos dgos/ gtor chog dang bzlas pa'i bar du ling ga la dmigs nas dgug gzhug mang du bya/ yab kyi nye snying gi mthar dgra bo che ge mo akṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥbla srog thams cad nā+-i dza dza zhes btags pa brgya nyi shu tsam dang*/ snying po dang rtsa sngags gang rung gcig la sngags de btags pa drug cu tsam dang*/ cig shos la stong phrag sogs gang mang du yum gyi snying po la'ang de dang mtshungs/ mjug tu 'phreng sngags la spel tshig sbyar ba nyer gcig tsam bzla/ de nas yang gtor bsngo byas te/ mjug tu rjes chog rnams bya ba yin kyang las sbyor ma tshar bar du 'khor dang gtor mgron tsho yang dbang po'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin gyi gshegs gsol mi byed de/ de ltar na thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa bya/ de 'dra zhag gsum mam bdun gyi bar byas pas khugs pa'i rtags 'byung ste spyi dang 'dra/ de nas kyang mi 'bros par bya ba'i phyir dgug gzhug bcings mnyes mang du byed pa gal che ste zhag gcig gnyis gsum gang rung bya'o/ /

de nas bzung thun mtshams su ag rtse khung sngags kyi shog ril gyis bkag /de tshun la thun bsgrub par bya yi brdeg mi dgos/ 'di nas bzung rdeg go /sbrags sgrub kyi skabs 'dir yab yum kyi sngags bzla mkhan so sos byed par bshad pa/ cig yod kyang sgrub pa po gcig nyid kyis sngags gnyis ka bzla ba ka da lta'i lag len la bde bar 'ong*/ mi mang pos bsgrubs na yang thams cad kyis gnyis kas bzla ba la brtson par bya'o/ /cho ga'i rim pa gzhan 'dra ba las snga gtor song ba'i rjes la dgug gzhug tshar gsum byas nas thod pa'i dpral ba'i khung mtshams nas bton pa'i srad bu de la drag po'i gzungs thag btags te bzung*/ mang pos bsgrubs na'ang gzungs thag mi gcig pa re re dgos so/ /bsad sngags dang bcas pa'i sngags thams cad tshar gcig brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs las pho nya dpag tu med pa spros/ 'khor lo'i gshin rje yab yum zhal sprod du yod pa'i zhabs gnyis kyi bar mtshams su sgrub bya de spyi bo tshugs sam/ gan rkyal du 'dug pa la bsad las mdzad par bsams te nye snying dang yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa re'i mthar bsad sngags btags/ snying po dang rtsa sngags gnyis so/ /gang rung gcig la bsad sngags btags pa 'phreng skor tsam dang*/ cig shos la yum gyi sngags btags/ de la bsad sngags btags pa stong phrag sogs ji ltar 'os par bzla/ bsad sngags ni nā sha ya staṃ bha ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa dang 'khor lo la 'bri ba'i trig nan sogs kyang yin/ 'phreng ba'i sngags la duṣtan zhes pa'i gnas su bsgrub bya'i ming 'jug pa ma gtogs bsad sngags la sogs pa mi dgos te rang shugs kyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 'phreng ba'i sngags bzla ba'i tshul la nyin par yab kyi sngags gtso bor bzla ste/ nyin phyed yan la oṃ kā la rū pa ya sha trun che ge mo trā sa ya nas tsu rṇa tsu rṇa huṃ phaṭa ces pa dang*/

dgongs phyogs oṃ kā la rū pa ya sha trun che ge mo tsakṣa badzre ṇa zhes pa nas/ staṃ bha ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa bzla/ gshin rje'i pho nya gtso bor gyur pa'i dmag tshogs kyis dgra bo bsad bcad kyi las byed par bsam/ mthar yum gyi 'phreng sngags bdun tsam re bzla'o/ /srod thun gyi skabs hriḥtsa munṭūi ye sha trun che ge mo dhu na dhu na nas bya dhi ro ga ṇaṃ phaṭa/ ces pa bzla/ tho rangs hriḥtsa munṭī sha trun che ge mo nye ga na shaṃ baṃ ces pa nas/ na sha ya hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar bzla/ mjug tu yab kyi 'phreng sngags bdun tsam re yang bzla'o/ /gshin rje mo gtso bor gyur pas dgra bo bsad bcad kyi las mdzad par bsam/ nye snying gi skabs su thun mi 'debs/ sngags gzhan rnams kyi skabs su 'brub khung gi phyi la ma bo bar thod pa la thun brdegs te/ pho sngags la skam thun dang mo sngags la rlon thun sngags de dang de la thun sgrub kyi sngags dang ha la ha la bhyoḥdang trag rakṣa bhyoḥbatags pas brdeg go / skabs de dag ci rigs par gu gul gyis bdug cing lha dbye ba'i dmigs pa bya yi/ gzhan lha dbye mi dgos par grags/ ci ste byed na gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor chen mo dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /'dir cho ga'i yan lag la med kha med min kyang nyin phyaid kyi thun la drag po'i sbyin sreg re 'bul thub na'ang legs so/ /de ltar bsgrubs pas zhag bdun nam zla phyed nyer gcig tshun la bsad rtags nges par 'ong ngo*/ /bsad rtags ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mi nag pho mos dgra bsad pa dang glo snying mchin pa ster mkhan byung zhing zos pa rmi na nges can du byed do/ / da ni 'di dpyad de bca' gzhi'i skabs su rgya ston gyis bzhed pas/ zhal dbye ma thod 'og tu byas/ ya thod kyis steng nas 'geb par bzhed pa ni/ zhal dbye'i skabs bris lang la thun thebs pa gcig dgos pa la/ ag tse khung kha 'og tu bstan na de mi rung ba dang*/

zhal dbye spyi'i lugs dang yang 'gal bas de mi legs so/ /'bri khung dpal 'dzin sbrags sgrub kyi skabs 'dir rab tu ma thod pho mo gnyis/ 'bring du ma thod gang rnyed gnyis kha sbyor byed/ tha ma ka pā la kha sbyor yin/ yab rkyang du sgrub pa kho na la ya thod ma thod kha sbyor byed/ sbrags sgrub la de mi byed par 'dod do/ /de mi 'thad de spyir thod pa kha sbyor rkyang sgrub sbrags sgrub thabs thams cad la rung mod kyang ma thod kha sbyor byed pa 'di zhal dbye spyi'i lag len dang 'gal zhing*/ rtog pa las thod pa'i nang du 'jug par bshad pa la ka pā la med na ma thod kho na la thod pa'i tha snyad mi 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ sbrags sgrub kyi skabs gong gi thod par bcug par bya zhes rkyang sgrub kyi skabs la kha 'phangs mdzad skabs der rgya srub la yi ge 'bri ba dang bandha sro bar bshad na ma thod la de gnyis ka mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ / thod ngan kyi nus pa ni gtso bor ka pā la la yod pa yin pas/ de bor na thod ngan 'bad pas btsal ba don med du 'gro lags/ de bzhin du dpal 'dzin ni 'phreng ba'i sngags bzlas na las 'gyang ba myong bas grub gsungs na yang khong rang gi de la bsnyen pa ma mdzad pa'am/ sngags ma dag pa las byung ba yin gyi/ 'khor lo'i sngags bzlas pas las 'gyangs pa min no/ /sngags thung rnams la bsnyen pa song*/ 'phreng sngags la ma song na 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams ched gtad bzla ba mi rung yang bsnyen pa song na 'khor lo'i sngags bzlas pa nyid ches myur ro/ /rtsa sngags gnyis po'i yang phyed snga mas dregs pa las la bsdu/ phyed phyi mas gtor zhing las la 'gyed pa'o/ /de ltar sgrub pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ste lnga pa'o/ / da ni las la sbyor ba bshad par bya ste/ gsang rtags byung ba nas las la sbyor te/ sngar gyi sgrub pa'i 'phros de la ka byed dgos kyi/ bar mtshams chod na mi rung ngo*/

/skabs der bzheng pa'am snga nas yod kyang rung ste grog mkhar la sogs pa bdun gyis sa dang ro sol dang dug khrag sna tshogs bsres pa'i sa la gshin rje'i gzugs rgyun du ji ltar sgom pa dang mthun pa gcig bya/ gzugs 'di la yab rkyang dang sbrags sgrub la khyad med/ gshin rje pho kho nas chog /de yang pho gtso bo yin pa'i gnad kyis kyang yin/ 'khor lo la bgo bsha' dang thod pa la bgo bsha' byar mi rung ba dang*/ yum gyi skur bzhengs kyang nang bzhugs 'jug rgyu med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /sku de gsar du bzhengs pa yin na skabs 'dir bris sku dang mthun par rab gnas bya'o/ /de nas sku de'i lto bar sngar gyi thod pa kha sbyor gzhug /sku'i rgyab tu thun khung la thun lam btod/ thod pa nyid la 'bab par bya/ de yang ag tse khung gi nang ngam spyi bo'i steng gang rung la yong ba byed/ dmar gtor chen po gcig bsham/ bsang gtor yin yang las ma grol bar 'dzin gtor dang 'dra/ cho ga'i rim pa sngar dang mthun/ thun brdeg pa'i tshe rang nyid yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos sku gzugs kyi rgyab tu 'ongs nas lcags thur sogs kyis blangs nas thun khung du bsdig par bya'o/ / yang na rnying ma ba 'ga' lag ko gyon nas rdeg pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma rgyas par bshams/ byin rlabs kyi rjes la dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bya/ 'debs kha dang bsgral chog dmigs pa dang ngag tu bya/ dngos su phur bu 'debs pa sogs mi dgos/ de nas gtor 'bul dang bcol gtad drag po bya/ 'dzin gtor rgul bskyod mi btang bar/ thun gtor gsar pa de zor du 'phen par bya'o/ /dmigs pa ni rang nyid yi dam ri rab tsam gyi mdun du gzugs brnyan de srid pa thams cad khong du chud pa'i gshin rje dngos yi dam gyi sku'i phyed tsam du sleb pa 'jig rten gyi khams sam 'dzam bu'i gling lto bar chud pa zhig bsgom/

'brub khung nam mkha'i khams su mos/ gshin rje de'i lto bar ka pā la gshin rje'i grong khyer gyi nang du/ zhal dbye yod na de dang 'khor lo gshin rje yab yum nyid du mos pa'i zhabs 'og tu ling ga de bsgrub byar mos/ de zhabs 'og tu mnan pas bu dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing lus shig pa dang gcig /mtshon cha dang dbyug pa brgyab pas zhig pa dang gnyis/ 'khor lo pho nya pho mo 'jigs su rung ba rnams dang bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis bsad cing zos pa dang gsum/ gshin rje yab yum nyid kyis chom chom du gsol ba dang bzhi/ srid gsum khyab pa'i gshin rje'i sku'i nang nas pho nya drag gtum nang du spros/ 'khor lo'i phyogs bcu nas bskor te bsad las mdzad pa dang lnga/ dug dang khrag phab pas zhig cing rul bar byas pa dang drug /phyogs bcu nas ma 'bar bas thal bar byas pa dang bdun te/ de rnams rim can rim can du bskyar gyin yang yang bsgom/ sngags kyi sham bu zhal shes ni/ nri mā ra ya nṛ ma ra du ya ma snying ya ma khrag tshal pa bam rim dum bu dum bu rbad/ ces pa sngar gyi bsad sngags thams cad kyi 'jug tu gdags/ dri can sogs mi dgos/ nyin re bzhin nam thun bzhir phyi gtor grol mtshams ling chung re bsgral te gtor ma dang sbyin sreg btab/ de ltar zhag gcig gam gsum mam lnga'am bdun du bya/ de las lhag pa nam yang mi dgos/ nyer dgu lta bus dus rtsub mo'am/ mig mar dar ba sogs gza' skar rtsub po gang rung la rbad nas bzang bar grags shing*/ yang gcig tu gza'i tshes gtso mi che/ rang nyid dmigs pa gsal zhes zhe sdang skye ba'i dus der las la sbyar bas chog go / gang ltar yang nyi phyed dang nam phyed la dur khrod dam/ 'dre'i gnas su song la gtor ma gsum bsham/ dang po sde brgyad spyi la bsngos te dpang gzugs shags gdab las la bskul/ gtor ma gnyis pa ni gang la gtod pa'i gnas bdag lha 'dre de la bsngos te/

ngas khyod la 'di gtad pa yin pas thal bar brlag par gyis/ gtad do ma btang shor te bya/ be con gyi phyag rgyas sa gzhi dral bar bsam te sa brkos/ sor bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad las gting thung ba mi rung*/ de bas kyang ring pa bzang*/ der rdo'am shing leb kyi khang sgrom bya/ der gshin rje'i gzugs de kha sbub te bzhag nas dgra bo'i yul khams la gab ste 'dug par mos/ de nas gtor ma'i dum bu gcig bcug /raktas gtor/ steng nas rdo'am shing gis kha bkab/ sa rlan yod na mi legs pas sa skam par bya/ kha cig dong gru gsum du byed cing ro yam la rdo rgya gram bris pas steng nas 'gebs par 'dod pa'ang yod mod/ kho bo cag gi bla ma rnams 'khor lo gzugs brnyan gyi sbyaur ba can la rgya gram bris pa'i rdos 'gebs pa mi bzhed/ dong gru gsum yang spros pa tsam yin gsung ngo*/ / rgya gram dang ri rab gyis mnan pa ni/ mnan gtad spyi'i rigs 'gres shor ba yin/ yang na gzugs brnyan kha bub mi byed par dgra phyogs su zhal bstan te bzhag kyang chog /kha bub mtha' gcig tu mi dgos pa ni rtog bdun de dang cung mi 'dra ba dang rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig kyang snang ngo*/ /de rjes gtor ma gsum pa de gshin rje la phul la dmod bcol drag tu bya'o/ /de nas sol ba yod na spungs/ gang ltar yang sas bsgribs te mi mngon par bya'o/ /de nas de'i steng du yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos drag po'i bro rdung sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i mtshams gcod rnams byas/ lam du bsrung 'khor bsgom/ sgrub khang du slebs nas mdun bskyed la mchod pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig bya/ de tsam gyis las 'grub kyang las kyi mtha' gtsang ba'i phyir drag po'i sbyin sreg ji ltar 'os pa bya'o/ /thun rdzas 'thor ba dang gtor ma gsos pa'i mtheb kyu sogs kyang bsreg skul drag po byas te drag po'i las kyi gtor ma de yang zor du 'phang*/

mchod bstod sogs rjes chog rgyas par bya/ de dag gi bya ba mtha' dag zin pa'i rjes su/ de ma thag pa'am nyi ma gcig gnyis song nas 'brub khung gi shul lam ji ltar 'os par yi dam mam chos rgyal lcam dral la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi mchod pas mnyes par bya'o/ / drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs gtor ma yang rgya cher btang*/ des ni las kyi mtha' shin tu bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /phyi rtags ma rdzogs bar du bskul ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar na 'di nyid kyi rtog pa las 'khor lo'i mtha' ma gzugs brnyan la sbyor ba kho na gsungs pa bzhin 'dir yang de ltar bshad zin la/ rwa lugs kyi yig rnying grags che ba 'di dang rgya ston dang bod kyi dpal 'dzin sogs de ltar zhag gsum byas nas kyang ches ma dag par ston nas ga'u bsre bar 'dod cing*/ gnyos skyo zhang gsum gyi yig sna thor bu rnams la yang de dang mthun par zur tsam snang ngo*/ /'on kyang gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor bas rtags ma byung na thod pa kha sbyor zhal dbye'i ga'u gzugs brnyan gyi khog nas bton te bsreg par 'dod pa dang*/ rgya ston na re/ thod pa dang gzugs brnyan gnyis kar mes gdung gsung spogs chog tu dgongs pa dang*/ de dag phal cher rtags ma byung na mes gdung dang*/ de nas rtags byung ba na lder bzo'i khog par bcug ste sbed par 'dod pa sogs ni mi legs so/ /des ni rtog pa 'dir ma gsung kyang rtog bdun gyi cho gas rigs bsgres na/ yang na ga'u me la sros pas tsha sgrub byed/ yang na ga'u rang sbed pa'i mnan pa byed/ yang na gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor bas rbod gtong 'dzugs pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun gyi dgongs pa'ang de kho na yin/ 'khor lo gcig la thams cad spungs na a pa tsa ob lang ro gcig la bsreg rgyu dang sbed rgyu'i dper 'gro'o/ / de'i dbang du byas nas gal te ga'u sro bar 'dod na 'di lta ste/

'khor lo rang yun ring du bsgrubs kyang rtags ma byung na 'brub khung gi nang du ro rdo'i sgyed pu gsum 'dzom mam/ mi bsad pa'i gri lcags kyi sgyed bu'i steng du thod pa kha sbyor gyi ga'u bzhag /de dag ma 'byor na dug shing ngam tsher ma can gyi shing gi yu ba btags te zung bas kyang rung*/ 'brub khung du mi ro sreg pa'i 'gal dum dang dug shing dang 'bras sam dzu tshe'i phur ma dang*/ seng ldeng sogs la me spar te me bdag gam me lce la cung zad sro zhing bsad sngags drag tu bzla ba dang*/ mes bsregs pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor bsgom/ nam phyed nyi phyed la de lta bu yud re byas pas des rtags thams cad 'byung ba yin no/ /dgra la nus pa byung na 'khor lo bton te las mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ /yang na 'khor lo de bsgrubs pas nang rtags byung yang phyi rtags 'gyangs na/ slar yang mchod gtor sbyin sreg sogs dang bcas zhag gsum tsam drag tu bskul nas ga'u nyid mnan gtad du byed/ yang na gzugs brnyan gyi sbyaur ba gong bzhin bya'o/ /ga'u sro ba dang ga'u mnan gtad kyi man ngag gi gshin rje gshed kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ / des na rang lugs la tsha sgrub dang gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba gnyis ka 'khor lo gcig kho na la byed du mi rung zhing las sbyor sgrub thengs gcig la gnyis kar mi dgos mod/ ci ste nus pa che la re nas byed 'dod na 'khor lo gnyis dang 'brub khung gnyis byas te bsgrubs na rung ngo*/ /des mtshon te 'khor lo gsum gyis las gsum byas kyang rung mod kyi/ 'khor lo gnyis gsum dus gcig tu sgrub pa 'di 'dra'i rigs bsnyen song mang por phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa'i rigs la rung gi gcig gi sgrub pa'i rigs la nus pa chung ngo*/ /des na nus pa che na spogs chog mi dgos/ spogs chog dgos rigs kyi'ang nang sel dbye na gsum ste/ grub bka' na gzugs brnyan sbyaur ba dgos/

'bring la ga'u mnan par sba/ 'grub sla na ga'u sro bar bshad pa yi dam gyi las tshogs skabs byed pa bzhin du 'dir yang rig par bya la/ deng sang go rgya tsam yin gyi/ rtog pa nyid las dngos su gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir da lta lag len du 'debs rgyu ni/ gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba nyid do/ /

da ni lhag ma las gsum zur tsam smos na/ 'khor lo'i skabs gshin rje yab yum gyi 'khor lo la/ nang ka gdung gi thig mi byed par/ thig rkyang gis chog /de'i phyir de'i sngags kyang mi dgos/ rtsib la gshin rje pho mo'i 'phreng sngags mi 'god pas nang ma brgyad la ya ma me da kṣe spel tshig dang bcas pa kho na 'god/ de yang ji lta bu snyam na rang rang so so'i dbus su ya shar du bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas/ shar nas g.yas skor gyis ma me da kṣa 'god/ de'i mthar che ge mo shan ting ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma brgyad la ya kā la rū pa zhes pa gong dang 'dra bar bris pa la spel tshig gis bskor/ yum gyi 'khor lo la yang nang ma brgyad la/ dbus su ma ma shar nas g.yas skor gyi tra ka ra ka sha mu tra zhes pa'i mu tra gcig tu byas pa dang*/ phyi ma brgyad la hriḥtsa munṭī ye'am/ tsam tsa munṭī ye spel tshig can 'dri/ zhi ba la yab yum sku mdog dkar po g.yon pas bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyas pa la ser po g.yon pas nor bus gang ba'i ka pā la 'dzin pa/ zhi rgyas la lha zhal gtso bor byed/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can no/ /dbang la dmar po yab kyi phyag g.yon na lcags kyu'o/ /lha zhal dang ma he'i zhal 'dam kha yin/ rgyan zhi rgyas dang 'dra/ yum mda' gzhu 'gengs par bya/ gnyis ka'ang bdag cer bu'o/ /dbyug pa dang rtse gsum yang kha dog dang mtshan ma las dang mthun par bya'o/ / lhag ma 'khor lo sgrub tshul dpal gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bskrad dbye mnan pa rnams kha bsgyur lugs tsam shes na spyi khog bsad las dang 'dra/ rtog pa'i dngos bstan la bsad las kho na gsungs kyang*/ las gzhan rnams la 'don pa spo lugs de ltar shes dgos so/ /de ltar na las sbyor gyi rim pa gsal bar bshad pa ste drug pa'o/ / da ni nye bar mkho zhing dgos nges shes pa'i lag len 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/

de la lcam dral 'di'i bka' gtad thun mong ma yin pa de byed na/ maṇḍal nag po gru gsum tshom bu gnyis pa zhig bya/ yab kyi gtor ma la shas mang du brgyan/ til nag nas nag sogs 'bru nag po'i rigs dang*/ srog chags nag po'i sha dang*/ chang mang tsam blug /rakta cung zad bran/ dar ram ras nag pos brgyan/ yum gyi gtor ma la rakta mang du bran te/ snod du 'khyil bas mtha' 'khor bar bya/ myos byed cung zad tsam gyis chog /nya shas brgyan pa lhag po yin/ sgog btsong la phug shing 'bras sogs yod na gnyis ka la 'debs/ me long bzhi byas/ gcig la snying po/ gcig la nye snying*/ gcig la rtsa sngags/ gcig la yum gyi snying po rnams khrag dang dri bzang bsres pas bris/ bdag bskyed yi dam dang*/ yi dam gyi bum bsgrub bya/ mdun skyed gshin rje sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs gsol btab dang gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed/ slob ma gshin rje yab yum du bskyed/ me long gi rtsa sngags bkrus te spyi bo nas blugs/ 'thung ngu gzhug /ye shes pa bstim/ sku'i adzñā yin/ snying po bkrus nas mgrin par gtor zhing 'thung du gzhugasngags rnams spyan drangs te bstim/ gsung gi adzñā yin/ nye snying bzlas shing snying khar gtor 'thung du gzhug /phyag mtshan bstim/ thugs kyi adzñā yin/ yab kyi gtor dbang bskur te/ bka' bgo'i mthar yab kyi 'phreng sngags drag tu bzlas/ slob ma la bstim/ ye shes rdo rje'i adzñā yin/ de nas yang slob ma yum du bskyed de gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ sngags gcig las med pas me long gcig pu de nyid bkrus pa'i khu ba las gsum mthor zhing gtor ba yin/ gtor dbang gi skabs su slob dpon gyis yum gyi 'phreng sngags drag tu bzla/ de nas skad cig gis yab yum mnyam par sbyaur ba'i skur bsgom du bcug la/ bzlas lung sbyin te nye snying la lan nyer gcig

/snying po dang yum gyi sngags lan bdun bdun rtsa sngags la lan gsum/ 'phreng sngags gnyis po lan re rjes zlos byed/ de nas slob ma'i spyi bor bla ma yi dam sgom du bcug /de thim pas yi dam du gyur/ gnas gsum dang skyai mched byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes phab/ bum chus dbang bskur rgyas btab/ snying khar yi dam gyi sngags dang*/ lte bar bhyoḥgasal btab/ gtor ma lag tu gtad nas bka' bsgo bya/ yab yum lte bar thim/ gtor ma gnyis nas cung zad re sby-in no/ /'di shin tu bka' dog/'di la tshogs 'khor med ka med yin/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ / ༈ chos rgyal 'di mthu las tshogs tsam ma yin par gtsug lag khang gi dkor srung dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong ba'i chos skyong chen por bsgrubs na/ dben pa'i gnas su rten bca' ste/ sa bzang po rin po che dang bsres pa la/ stegs bu gru bzhi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum dpangs su mtho gang ba/ stegs bu dang bcas par bzhengs/ phyi nang thams cad gri khrag rang byung dug dang bcas pas byugs/ stegs bu la 'og thog bya/ der drag po'i'akhor lo bca' gri snying bca' thabs spyi dang 'dra ba la rtsa dbus mar 'khor lo 'jug tu de bri gzhi dar la 'khor lo rtsibs drug /lte bar oṃ/ rtsibs drug la yi ge lhag ma drug /oṃ gyi g.yas g.yon du ya re mgo bo phyir bstan bri/ lte ba'i mu khyud la 'dod don 'dri/ mu khyud nang ma la tsa munṭi'i snying po dang*/ phyi ma la rab gnas kyi snying po rnams ser rkyang ngam/ ser po bsres pa'i snag tshas bri/ yang na mtshal gyi bris kyang rung ngo*/ /'di rten yin pas yig mgo phyir bstan rang byed/ dbus kyi yig mgo la nub bcol dgos gsung*/ de gzhogs g.yon nas sgrim te/ mgo mjug ma nor bar gzhug /de lcags kyi ga'ur bcug la gru gsum gyi nang du gzhug /gru gsum der phyag mtshan dbyug to dang*/ gri gug dang*/

ral gri dang mdung thung rnams la yab kyi snying po rtsa sngags gang rung bris pa dang rtse gsum la yum gyi snying po bris pa dang zhags pa dang*/ thod pa sogs la yi ge med pa'ang gzhug /steng nas lcags sam g.yam pa'i kha gcod kyis bcad/ de ni chos skyong spyi dang mthun par gsang ba'i rten yin/ gru gsum gyi phyi ngos la nye snying rtsa sngags/ snying po gnyis sogs kyi mthar/ chos rgyud 'di'am gtsug lag khang 'di yi bstan pa skyongs shig /ces pa bri'o/ / yang chos byung de nyid kyi rgyab phyogs su bzhags pa'am/ gzhan du yang rung ste/ yab kyi mdung nag po ba dan dang dar nag can la/ gzhan gri snying gi 'khor lo de dang 'dra ba las/ mu khyud nang ma la yab rang gi rtsa sngags 'bri/ de bzhin du ma he nag po snying dgos kyang ma rnyed na g.yag nag gi snying gi rtsa sbugs su 'khor lo de ka 'dra ba bcug pa mgul du btags/ yum gyi rten rtse gsum dmar po la dar dmar gang yod kyang 'dra/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar bhyoḥ'i g.yas g.yon du ma gnyis/ lte ba'i mu khyud la 'dod gsol/ rtsibs bcu la/ snying po 'bru bcu/ mu khyud nang ma la brtan zhugs dang*/ bar pa la dbyangs bcu drug dang*/ phyi ma la yedhar mas bskor ba bri/ yig mgo phyir bstan dang dbus kyi yi ge la nub bcol/ khyi mo nag mo'i sny-ing gi rtsa sbugs su 'khor lo de ka 'dra ba bcug pa mgul du btags/ yang na phyag mtshan gnyis kyi tshab mda' dar la bya ste/ snying gnyis po mda' dar gyi mgul du btags kyang rung ngo*/ /ha la nag po dang gri thod cad la'ang 'di'i rigs 'dre/ de bzhin du sa khams pa la rin po che brdar ba la/ gri khrag bsres te ma he byas pa'i khog par/ 'khor lo de dang*/ mi sha dang*/ dngul rdog dang*/ shel dang*/ rdo pha bang la ya drug bris pa gzhug /rgyu de las ro langs sug bzhi btsugs pa'i gzugs kyi khog tu yum gyi 'khor lo dang*/

nya sha dang*/ gser dang byu ru'am/ mi rus la bhyoḥbris pa gzhug/mdung dar gnyis dang srog chags gnyis kyi rgyab la/ khyed 'di la rten chos la bstan pa srungs shig ces pa 'bri/ de dag ni phyi'i rten no/ / yang rtag gtor ni/ gtor ma che chung gnyis spyi dang mthun par byas pa las/ gtor ma la khong stong bcos pa'i nang du/ 'og tu bris pa'i ling chung pho mo re so sor bya/ de'i steng du stag gi sha /sbrul sha /sha chen ra nag gi sha tshil/ 'bru nag bra bo sogs dang*/ bcas pa'i steng du 'khor lo so so gzhug /de'i steng du 'bru sna nor sna dar sna bzhag /sgo bkag /gzhan rtag gtor bsham tshul spyi dang 'dra/ de ni nang gi rten no/ /rtsa ba'i rten bris sku dang 'bur sku yang bsham dgos/ bris sku de yang yab stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang*/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs/ yum gos zu nag po dang glang lpags gsol ba'am/ yang na yab kyang dar nag ci rigs gsol ba dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan cung zad yod pa byas na sde de la bkra shis pa yin gsungs/ mtshon cha dang go cha dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa bzhag go /de dag gi rab gnas ni re re bzhin bya ste/ dam tshig bris sku'i rab gnas kyi rigs 'dre la/ rab gnas kyi cho ga gzhan nas kyang cung zad kha bskang ngo*/ /yang snying po'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba lte ba zlum po sor gnyis lhag tsam bskor/ der hūṃ gcig 'bri/ lte ba'i mu khyud la 'dod gsol gyis bskor/ de nas sor gsum tsam bskor ba'i bar la/ re mig phra mo bco brgyad bya/ thams cad la phugs su oṃ re/ de'i phyi ru ka nas dza'i bar gyi yi ge bco brgyad po re re 'bri/ de'i phyi la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swahā/ rnams brtsegs te 'bri/ thams cad kyi mtha'i mu khyud la 'dod gsol bri/ mtha' me ris skor/ rtsa sngags kyi 'khor lo ni/ bskor thig byed tshul snying po'i de dang 'dra ba las/ re mig gam rtsibs sum cu so gnyis bya/

thams cad kyi phugs su oṃ re re/ de'i phyi ru ya nas dza'i bar rtsa sngags yi ge so gnyis/ de phyir hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sngar bzhin bri/ 'khor lo 'di rnams kyi yi ge thams cad mgo nang lta yin/ lte ba'i yig mgo la shar 'chol lo/ /'khor lo 'di gnyis kyis las thams cad 'grub pa yin kyang*/ skabs 'di rtsa sngags kyi 'khor lo dar ser po la gser ram dngul gyis bri/ rab gnas bya/ rgya mtsho rlabs zer ba'i lte ba'i lugs de byas/ rdza bum che ba gsar ba'i nang du 'bru sna gos sna sprungs pa'i steng du/ steng 'og mdun rgyab ma nor bar bzhag /steng du sman sna dang nor sna sna tshogs kyis bkang ste/ dar gyis kha bkab nas sngar gyi phyi rten rnams dang lhan cig tu bzhagasger mchod byung na rab/ ma byung na thun mong gi mchod pa ma chags par bya/ dus dus su 'o ma dang zho gtor ro/ /'dis dgon gnas der longs spyod la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ 'byor pa 'phel ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can yin no/ / gshin rje'i 'khor yi dwags kyis nor la bar chad byed na gdams pa 'di dgos so/ /de bzhin du sny-ing po'i 'khor lo gro ga la zangs sam mtshal gyis bris/ rab gnas byas la bde ba lugs snga ma dang 'dra/ smad 'tshong ma'i thod pa kha sbyor ram zangs kyi ga'u mar dang sbrang rtsis gang ba'i nang du bcug /de yang chang snod rnying par bcug te kha ras dmar pos bkab/ mchod pa spyi dang dus dus su myos byed kyis gtor ro/ /'dis nang 'khrug sogs mi 'byung zhing gnas gzhi de la skye bo rnams gus pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /chos rgyal lha mgon gcig tu sgrub pa'i thabs ni rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i hūṃ la byang shar nas hūṃ dang lho nas ya bstim/ ye shes pa'i skabs su gnyis kar spyan 'dren/ thugs kar hūṃ gi mtha' skor du kā la rū pa de ṣa ra ra sgom nas sngags kyang de kha bzla/

ling ga'i nang du yaṃ ū ra ū ra bhu ra bhu ra hūṃ brtsegs pa bsgom pa'o/ / yang sde brgyad thams cad gshin rje'i 'khor yin/ 'gong po dang the rang gri mo sogs kyis chos grwa dang dge 'dun la bar du gcod/ mi snyan pa sgrog /tshe dang longs spyod dang sri la brku bas gdams ngag gzhan nas 'byung ba'i bse rags 'gong po gnon pa dang*/ mi la bse rags gnon pa dang*/ bya mgo can dang*/ bse gdong can dang*/ brel 'phongs dang*/ shes pa dkar po dang*/ mgo gsum gnon pa sogs/ de dag gang byas kyang go chod cing phan par 'ong*/ 'di nyid kyi rang lugs ni/ dang por phyogs mtshams brgyad la bgegs gtor mang du btang*/ khyad par du rgyal srid dang the rangs 'gong po sa bdag klu gnyan dang bcas pa la/ ched du dmigs pa'i bgegs gtor yas glud sogs mang du gtong zhing*/ thog ma nas nyi ma gsum mam lnga la sogs par gtong ngo*/ /de nas ma 'ongs shig bya/ de tsam gyis bskrod thub pa'i ltas byung na/ de ma thag phyogs mtshams rnams su tho tsugs lhar bskyed/ gtor ma phul/ rab gnas bya/ 'dod don gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'grub bo/ / da dung nges can du bskrad dgos na gro ga dang shog shog gang rnyed la/ dri tsa pa la thag ring du chos chos sen dhar yam yam chos chos dri ling chos chos dri'u dri'u chos chos ham sham dri chos chos na ga phu ga ga sa ga na ga gzhan du chos chos zhes pa mang du bris la rta thod skam par gcug /spre'u dang bya dang sbrul dang*/ jo bo zhwa theb can rta bzhon dang*/ bong bzhon dang*/ spyang ku la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan dang*/ nor sna zas sna gos sna 'bru sna tshogs dang*/ mi kha'i zas gsum dang bcas pa'i gtor ma rnams bgegs la bsngos/ bden pa bdar/ 'di na sdod pa'i gnas med ga ge mo na ge mo na skyid do byas/ lha khang gnas gzhi gog po'am/ grong khyer chen po'i 'dabs su bskyal/ de ma thag tho brtsegs/

bsrung 'khor drag tu bsgom pa sogs byas pas 'grub bo/ /shin tu rang 'tshub na mnan pa bya ste/ de yang bsnyen pa kha gsos/ bshan pa pho mo'i 'khor lo gong bzhin las/ bgegs la kha sbos/ 'khor lo kha sbyor gyi nang du/ bgegs ling mang po'i bcug /rab gnas dgug gzhug ltab rtsis dkris sogs brgyab/ 'brub khung du bcug nas/ zhag gsum mam bdun sogs bsgrubs shing*/ dgug gzhug bcings mnyes dang*/ steng du mchod rten gyis mnan cing drag tu sgrub/ de nas khyi nag po'i thod pa'i nang du bcug /lam rgya gram du mnan pa spyi dang mthun par mnan pas rung ngo*/ /yang na snying po dang rtsa sngags kyi 'khor lo kha sbyor dang yum brgyad gyi srog 'khor rnams kyi nang du/ bgegs ling bcug te mnan kyang rung ngo*/ /yum gyi srog 'khor dang 'dra rung la/ dbus su hūṃ dang yab kyi nye snying 'bri/ phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la ma bhyoḥbargyad 'bri/ kha sbyor bar du mo 'dre'i ling ga bcug / ling ga gro ga dang*/ 'khor lo zangs glegs la bris nas/ sngar gyi snying po'i de dang*/ bca' gzhi 'dra ba la/ steng du mchod rten gyis mnan te bzhag na sde de la bud med kyi gnod pa dang*/ mi bgegs mi 'byung ngo*/ / shin tu mkho ba'i man ngag gal chen 'ga' zhig gi skabs te bdun pa'o/ / da ni gzhan yang 'di ltar rig par bya stai/ las gshin gyi rtog pa 'dir dngos bstan tshig don la pho rkyang du sgrub pa dang/ pho mo sbrags te sgrub pa gnyis gsal bar bstan/ gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bo sbrags sgrub yin/ pho rkyang du grub pa yang dngos su gsungs pas/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa'ang zhor la 'phangs so/ /

pho rkyang dang mo rkyang du sgrub pa rnams pha rol po las shugs chung ba dang srung bzlog ngan na rno myur che bar yong yang tshan kha chung zhing 'khu dog mang bar grags/ sbrags sgrub byin che bkra shis stobs che shing rno bar yang yongs gsungs nas/ lag len sbrags sgrub la byed/ yang pho rkyang mo rkyang la mthu tsam 'ong*/ yang bstan srung chos bdag tu byed na/ yab yum du sgrub pa'am lcam dral du sgrub par nges par dgos/ 'khor mang du byed na'ang rno zhing bzang bar bzhed do/ /'dir kho bo cag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma rnams 'di skad gsungs te/ spyir gshin rje la phyogs mtshams brgyad dang 'brel ba'i brgyad dam/ de'i steng du dbus bsnan pas dgu/ yang na dbus la steng 'og gnyis su phye bas bcu yang yod/ ya ba ti la sogs pa phyogs mtshams kyi gshin rje brgyad/ yum dang bcas pa kun la grags mod kyang gzhan gyi 'khor du sbyar ba ma gtogs/ so so'i sgrub thabs kha gsal can grags che ba cher med/ de dag dang don gcig pa la ming gzhan gyis bstan pa ni/ dper brjod na khrag mdog lcam dral lta bu shar phyaugs ky-i gshin rje yin/ ma ru rtse bzhi skor lta bu shar lho'i gshin rje dang*/ ra hu la lta bu lho nub kyi gshin rje yin yang gsung*/ res 'ga' las gshin ha la nag po lta bu yang lho nub kyi gshin rje'i rigs su 'gyur gsung*/ rnam sras gshin rjer sgrub pa lta bur byang phyogs kyi gshin rje yin/ te lo'i rtog pa nas 'byung ba'i lha mgon lta bu byang shar gyi gshin rje yin/ dbus kyi gshin rje ni dur khrod nag po nas bshad pa nag po ro 'dzin gyi lugs/ mgon po bcu bdun ma lta bu yin cing*/ steng 'og gnyis su phye na de nyid steng gi yin par 'gyur/ nub dang 'og gi gshin rje ni na ga rakṣa lta bu yin/ rtog pa 'di dang las gshin bcu gsum ma la sogs pa las gshin dngos 'di lho phyogs kyi yin/

nub byang gi gsal kha can rang ma rnyaid kyang*/ mon pa ke ta lta bu yin pa 'dra'o gsung*/ man ngag rig pa'i gsung yin te don la'ang gnas par mngon/ rtog pa 'dir mtsho ma dros pa'i thad du gnas par bshad pas/ byang phyogs kyi ma yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ phyaugs mtshams kyi gshin rje brgyad po yang phyogs skyong brgyad dang 'brel ba yin/ phyogs skyong gi gnas kyi dbang du byas na/ ri rab kyi rtse mo dbus su bzhag /ri rab dang bar ma chad pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad gnas nang ma yin/ gl̥ng bzhi'i thad kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad gnas bar pa yin/ des na mtsho ma dros pa 'dzam gl̥ng gi dbus la rten pa yin/ lho phyogs kyi gling yin pa'i phy-ir lho'i gshin rje'i gnas su 'gyur/ 'di skabs kyi gshin rje'i gnas mtshams kyi tsho zur thig gi steng du dgos pas gling phran la ma yin rgya mtsho yin no/ / gnas phyi ma brgyad kyi phyi ni lcags ri'i nang mtshams la rtsi ba yin te/ lho phyogs dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol zer ba'ang de la bsam pa'o/ /dbus kyi gshin rje'i gnas ni ri rab kyi khong seng sa 'og go /yang steng 'og gnyis su dbye na/ ri rab kyi rtse mo dang smad gzhi la'ang ngos 'dzin no/ /rnam grangs du ma byas na de ltar yin yang*/ gtso bo gcig la bsdu na gshin rje'i ldog pa nas lho phyogs kyi gshin rje rang gtso bo yin pas thams cad de la 'dus/ dregs pa spyi ldog nas byas na dbus kyi de gtso bo yin mod/ spyir drag sngags kyi dregs pa pho rgyud thams cad gshin rje dang srin po la 'dus/ mo rgyud thams cad ma mo dang mkha' 'gro la 'dus/ mgon po nag po'i chos skor rnams kyang shas cher srin po dang 'brel ba dang/ dbang phyug dang 'brel ba dang*/ dregs pa spyi dang 'brel ba yang mang po yod do/ /spyir de ltar yin yang nyams len gyi skabs su/ gang dang gang gi sgrub thabs su zhugs pa de dang de nyid skabs der gtso bo byed dgos pa yin pas/

gtso 'khor la phyogs gcig pa'i a 'thas byar mi rung*/ lha dpon res g.yog res zhes grong pa'i kha na rgyu ba de yang phyogs gcig nas 'thad du rung ngo*/ /de dag las 'dir lag len gyi mthil du 'debs rgyu sbrags sgrub kyi skor rnams bshad zin to/ / rkyang sgrub tu byed na mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa nas brtsam de mi 'dra ba cung zad yod/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ni sbrags sgrub kho nas mchog cing 'di kho nas legs kyi/ rkyang sgrub kyi rtsa bsnyen mi legs so/ /de phyin chad la pho rkyang du bsgrubs na bris sku yang yab rkyang 'bri/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ bzlas pa dang/ gtor ma yang yum gyi skor rnams bor ba ka yin/ sgrub pa'i skabs su zhal dbye yod na ya thod nyid la yab kyi 'khor lo 'gri ba'am/ 'khaur lo logs su bris zin pa de thod pa la sbyor ba gang rung bya/ thod pa'i nang rdzas ngan zab zob kyis bgegs pa de mi dgos/ thod pa'i nang ji ltar 'os par bris ling ngam/ de snying khar bcug pa'i nya bo'i gzugs de shing bkag gi steng du gan rkyal du gnas pa dam rtsis sbyar de yo 'gul med par bzhag /de'i steng nas ma thod gshin rje'i gzugs kyis 'gebs pa yin/ 'di la nges par ag rtse khung la khun lam btod dgos so/ /thod pa kha sbyor yin na thod pa steng ma la yang 'khor lo 'bri ba'am sbyor de/ de'i tshe 'og ma dang kha sbyor du don gyis song*/ sngags kyang gcig pas dang por 'bri lugs gcig byas na/ 'dir g.yas g.yon 'jol 'gro bas 'og g.yas skor dang*/ steng ma g.yon skor du 'bri'o/ kha cig thod pa kha sbyor la steng ma'i tshangs bug tu thun lam btod pa'i srol yang 'dug ste/ 'di ni 'khor lo la gnod pas shin tu mi rung la/ spyir yang thod pa nyams par 'gyur bas cung de mi legs par mngon no/ /de man chad sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs rnams su/ yum gyi skor rnams bor ba kho na'o/

/de bzhin du yum rkyang sgrub na yang*/ bris sku yang yum kho na bzhengs/ sgrub pa'i skabs zhal dbye byed na/ ya thod la yum gyi 'khor lo kho na bris/ ma thod skan gyi phyogs la gshin rje'i sku rang byung ni gsal 'debs rgyu de gshin rje mo'i rnam par bya/ sngags ni dpral bar nye snying dang*/ ma ma rakṣa yakṣa hūṃ dza hūṃ/ ya ma rā dza ṇṛ dza dza zhes pa zhal gyi thad la bri/ ma ma ru lu ma he bhyoḥ che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mtha' la bri ba ni khyad par yin/ thod pa kha sbyaur yin na'ang*/ 'khor lo 'bri ba'am kha sbyor te/ 'khor lo 'og ma la g.yon skor dang*/ steng ma la g.yas skor ro/ / las sbyaur gyi skabs lder bzo yang tsa muṇḍi nyid bzhengs/ gzhan cho ga lhag ma yab kyi bskor bor ba kho na yin/ rkyang sgrub 'di gnyis la nyin mtshan gyi sngags kyang pho mo so so rkyang ba las 'os med kyang*/ phyed mar bcad nas bzla ba de mi dgos/ 'phreng sngags nye bsnyen gyi skabs bzhin bzla'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan bsdu ba dang*/ 'gyed pa'i las de phos mo bskul ba dang*/ mos pho bskul ba la dgos kyi gzhan la ma yin pas so/ /de bzhin du 'khor lo yang rkyang sgrub la 'khor lo gcig las med pa zhal dbye lta bu la der zad/ thod pa kha sbyor re byed pa'i tshe g.yas skor g.yon skor so sor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'khor lo gnyis po sngags kyi ngo bo gcig /dmigs pas kyang lha gcig tu mos dgos la/ re mig so so'i sngags steng 'og tu 'grig pa zhig dgos/ de min sngags 'khrugs pa las ji bzhin mi 'grub na/ dper na lag ngar g.yas pa'i sha lpags ky-i nang du g.yon pa'i rus pa bcug na tshigs mtshams mi 'grig pa bzhin no/ /sngags sgrub kyi 'khor lo kha sbyaur la ni de dang mi 'dra ste sngags gnyis po ye mi gcig pas 'dra ba sgrig rgyu med pa dang*/ gnod sby-in 'khor lo la lha tshogs yab yum sgrig rgyu yod pa lta bu 'di la med pa dang*/

dmigs pas kyang lha yab yum so sor sgom zhing 'khor lo yang so sor rang rkang pa yin gyis gcig tu bsdu rgyu min pa'i phyir ro/ /pho rkyang la 'og ma g.yon skor kha gyen bstan dang*/ steng ma g.yas skor du bris pa kha sbub te sbyar bas g.yas skor du kha sbyor 'byung/ thabs rkyang pa mtshon pa yin/ mo rkyang la 'og ma g.yon skor du bris pa kha gyen bstan la/ steng ma g.yas skor du bris pa kha sbub pas g.yon skor kha sbyor du'ang shes rab rkyang pa mtshon/ sbrags sgrub kyi skabs gnyis ka g.yas skor du 'bri/ de la 'khor lo ltab tshigs ma byas na rnam spyi gsal te/ mo 'khor g.yas skor 'og nas kha gyen bstan de shes rab la thabs kyi zhad yod pa dang*/ 'pho 'khor g.yas skor du bris pa kha sbub pas g.yon skor du song ba de/ thabs la shes rab kyi zhad yod pa mtshon cing*/ g.yas skor g.yon skor kha sbyor du 'byung ba ni/ mtshan nyid tha dad pa gnyis bya ba gcig la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ / rkyang sgrub skabs thod pa la 'bri bar rtog pa las gsungs pas thob thang yin gyi/ gzhan 'khor lo 'bri tshul sbrags sgrub bzhin byas kyang las 'grub kyin yod pas 'gal ba yod pa ma yin no/ /de dag kyang rnyed cing 'grub na thod pa bam ril yongs rdzogs yod pa dang*/ gshin rje'i sku rang 'byung du yod pa'i rten 'brel gyis zhal dbye nyid nus pa che bar grags so/ /'dir yab rkyang dang yum rkyang dang yab yum mam lcam dral sbrags te sgrub pa 'dis mtshon te/ mngon rtogs kyi skabs dmigs gsal gyi 'khor bskyed pa'i lhag chos ma gtogs/ bcu gsum ma'am bcu bdun ma sogs la'ang cho ga'i rim pa 'di kho na sbyar bas rung ngo*/ /de bzhin du ha la nag po pho rkyang ngam lcam dral du byed na'ang*/ nye snying spos na 'di kho nas 'grub/ yang lag len khrigs bkod sogs nas bshad cing*/ man ngag las 'byung ba las gshin gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa gtso rkyang*/

re ma ti dang lcam dral du bya ste nye snying yang*/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ru pa sha hūṃ phaṭa ces bsgyur/ gzhan cho ga 'di nyid kyis las sgrub bo/ /gyi ljang ba'i mgon po gshin rje ltar grub pa yang 'di la 'khor mang du byas pa ka yin/ de dag la sogs pa rnam pa du mar 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ / yang 'dir rtog pa 'di la dngos su ma brten mod/ zhal gdams man ngag gzhan bstan pa ni/ phyi rol mu khyud gsum bskor ba la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang me ri 'bri/ de'i nang du mtshon cha 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la lte ba skor mi dgos/ rtsibs kyi rtse mo rnau zul ba mi byed par/ yi ge cha'i 'phong bzhin du cha shas gnyis pa gcig 'bri ba'i srol 'dug /rgyu mtshan gcig kyang 'chad la/ man ngag yi ge rnying pa rnams na ni gsal kha med/ rtsibs brgyad la dmu byad ma che ge rang nyid la log shog /de bzhin du rgyal po/ gshin rje/ gying 'dril/ dri 'dril/ bdud/ ma mo btsan ces pa rnams la/ gnod byed dam byad ma che ge mo rang nyid la log shog /ces pa shar nas go rim ji lta ba bzhin du g.yon skor yig mgo phyir bstan du 'bri/ de bzhin du shar dang shar lho'i mtshams kyi rtsibs bar la rmu 'khu staṃ sha trun sha trun staṃ bha ya nan laṃ/ de bzhin du rtsibs bar rnams la g.yon skor gyis rgyal po rgyal te rgyu dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ yul lha dang*/ gying 'dril dri 'dril dang*/ bdud dang*/ ma mo dang*/ btsan dang*/ cang te'u zhes pa rnams la/ 'khu staṃ sha trun sha trun/ staṃ bha ya nan laṃ/ zhes btags pa yig mgo nang bstan du 'bri/ 'khor lo'i dkyil du bsgrub bya brang 'jog byed pa/ rkang pa bskum zhing sgrog gis bsdams pa zhig 'bri/ bar lhu g.yas dang stod dang bar lhu g.yon rnams la/ kun drug thum ri li li zhes pa tshar gnyis lus po ma la sngags de'i rjes su bandhe pa sha ya bandhe pa sha ya zhes pa 'bri/
